answer.text: Erodes real purchasing power; affects all assets including cash

explanation.text: The Logic: Inflation risk is the risk that rising price levels reduce real purchasing power and the real rate of return; investors expect a nominal return that compensates for expected inflation. The Trap: Inflation risk is not confined to a single asset class — purchasing power erosion is a general effect on real returns. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.19-20, p.26.
